tools.name: edit_game
tools.description: Create one exact text edit in a listed games/ file as a separate local git commit and mcp-edit branch; optional PR only when a GitHub token is configured

tools.name: list_approved_components
tools.description: Exact original source modules with verified upstream Git blob

tools.name: search_approved_code
tools.description: Search approved code and return small matching line snippets

tools.name: inspect_approved_component
tools.description: Read a small window of original approved code

tools.name: list_game_files

tools.description: Run Claude META BOT (full mobile, desktop and second run; max 300 seconds, one run at a time)

tools.name: list_games
tools.description: List all self-hosted games directly from the META GAMES homepage
